pages.text: The $(item)Killing Pit$(): spikes in a hole. Every creature in it suffers, and suffering is Wrath.

pages.name: Killing Pit
pages.text: 5 by 5 floor, a wall two high round a 3 by 3 hole.

pages.title: Suffering
pages.text: Each second each creature inside pays Wrath by its size, and more the longer it has suffered. A death in it pays a burst.$(br2)The pit keeps what they drop and the experience they leave, for me to take when I pass. When I want none of it, it keeps nothing.

pages.title: Mercy, of a Kind
pages.text: At its second tier it calls monsters in at night. At its third it heals any creature under 30 parts in a hundred of its health, for 5 Corruption, so the suffering goes on.$(br2)I am not proud of the pit. I built it anyway.
